task: pick up the apple, walk left and place the apple on the plate
policy_family: pretrained vision-language-action model with diffusion/flow-matching action head plus pretrained whole-body RL controller
reference_video_selection: First recorded episode is displayed by default, including its failure. Every episode is retained.

resources.runtime_guard: Abort at each policy request if system MemAvailable falls below20%;GB10 RAM is shared withGPU.
resources.cpu_note: Captured jobs used a four-core cgroup quota and four Torch/OMP threads. Whole-host CPU headroom was not continuously logged; concurrent host load caused spikes reported by another worker. Reproduction additionally uses hard four-core affinity and a reactive host CPU/RAM pause guard.

runtime_changes: SDPA attention replaces flash-attn due wheelABIincompatibility
comparison: Separate official apple-to-plate task, not a matched comparison with TensorCode warehouse scene.
limitations: Four episodes are a small reference demonstration, not a robust benchmark estimate.
No training or task adaptation was performed.
SDPA numerical equivalence to the upstream FlashAttention runtime was not separately established.
Global Python/NumPy/Torch seeds were11 and19; upstream environment reset did not expose an explicit reset seed in this runner.

whole_body_RL_controller: floating-base quaternion and angular velocity read directly from simulator qpos/qvel
observation_boundary.simulator_exposure: Official environment also exposes full floating_base_pose/velocity/acceleration to its WBC wrapper. This reference has not been converted to the TensorCode sensor-derived state-estimation boundary.
observation_boundary.scope: No claim of a sensor-only or perception-only whole-body pipeline. No object coordinates or roottranslation are configured as high-levelVLA input modalities.
